en: Colorized historic postcard view of a street with a large brick and stone academic or hospital building on the right, featuring arched windows and decorative roof details. Several people in early-20th‑century clothing walk or stand in front of the building and along the street. On the left are additional multi‑story buildings and a stone fence with trees behind it. The sky is clear blue. Text along the top identifies the scene as university clinics in Cluj, written in Romanian and Hungarian.
